name: espacioapk.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 19 pages ask search engines not to index them.
lesson: Review every noindex on purpose, and remove it from pages you want found.
summary: espacioapk.com scores 82 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 21 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: other sites can frame the page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 19 pages ask search engines not to index them
fix.evidence: /juegos/ (noindex, follow), /juegos/estrategia/ (noindex, follow), /juegos/accion/ (noindex, follow), /juegos/arcade/ (noindex, follow) and 15 more.
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /, /juegos/, /juegos/estrategia/, for example .section:nth-child(3) > p > .more and .section:nth-child(4) > p > .more. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /juegos/, /juegos/estrategia/, /juegos/accion/, /juegos/arcade/ and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
